name: clipboard
description: System clipboard get/set/clear for local agents. Uses wl-copy/wl-paste on Wayland, falls back to xclip or xsel on X11. 'backends' reports which clipboard tools exist.
use_when: reading or writing the user's clipboard

args.name: get
args.description: Print clipboard contents to stdout (raw, not JSON).

args.name: set [text|--file path]
args.description: Copy text, file contents, or stdin to the clipboard.

args.name: backends
args.description: Report which clipboard tools exist and which would be used.

env.CLIPBOARD_BACKEND: Force backend: wl, xclip, or xsel.

stdout: Clipboard text on 'get' (raw); JSON ack on set/clear/backends.
notes: Setup: sudo dnf install wl-clipboard (Wayland) or xclip (X11).
